title: GoOrganicAfrica Gabon calculator readiness review

administrative_geography.source: Gabon Ministry of Interior, Territorial Organisation
administrative_geography.caveat: Ministry page published 2018 and reports DGAT counts dated May 2016. Do not mix lower-level units into the province selector; verify later legal changes before department-level spatial joins.

agricultural_evidence.finding: Official Ministry page confirms RGA launched in 2019 and lists the census report volumes. INSTAT lists EPVA 2022-2023 survey reports. Existing evidence records approximate national sector estimates and household-location shares, but original crop/province tables have not yet been extracted.

findings: Cassava and plantains are the main food crops; only small quantities of maize are produced.
FAO forecast 2026 cereal import requirements at 255,000 tonnes, including 170,000 tonnes of wheat and 70,000 tonnes of rice.
Above-average rainfall in the first half of 2026 caused flooding and soil oversaturation and may have affected the secondary maize crop.
seasonal_context.caveat: Cereal import requirements are forecasts, not domestic crop production or farmgate price data; rainfall impact is an assessment, not a measured final yield.

blockers: Extract crop and province tables from RGA and EPVA reports.
Reconcile reference periods, crop definitions and units with other national/international series.
Obtain current dated province-level farmgate prices.
Obtain current farmer-facing seed, fertilizer, crop protection, labour, machinery and irrigation costs.
Build province-appropriate enterprise budgets, currency handling, mappings and tests.

safeguards: Research-only lookup; not an active calculator profile.
No existing active country profile or calculator formula changed.
No prices, yields or production costs invented.
